description.text: If the day before yesterday is Thursday, then what is the day of the week after 3 days from today?

properties.html: If the day before yesterday is Thursday, then what is the day of the week after 3 days from today?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Number of odd days here is = 2+3 = 5 days
So, the day after 3 days will be = Thursday + 5 odd days = Tuesday.

description.text: If 1st January, 2016 is Friday, then what is the day of the week on 1st January, 2017?

properties.html: If 1st January, 2016 is Friday, then what is the day of the week on 1st January, 2017?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

As, 2016 is a leap year, no. of odd days = 366/7 … … … … 2 odd days
Therefore, 1st January, 2017 will be = Friday + 2 odd days = Sunday.

description.text: Consider today is Friday. What is the day after 1351 days from today?

properties.html: Consider today is Friday. What is the day after 1351 days from today?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

No. of odd days - 1351/7 … … … … … 0 odd days
So, after 1351 days, the day will also be Friday.

description.text: If the day after tomorrow is Sunday, then what was the day at yesterday?

properties.html: If the day after tomorrow is Sunday, then what was the day at yesterday?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Total number of odd days in between = 3
So, Yesterday was = Sunday – 3 odd days = Thursday

description.text: If Yesterday was Tuesday, what will be the day after 5044 days from today?

properties.html: If Yesterday was Tuesday, what will be the day after 5044 days from today?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Today is = Wednesday
No. of odd days = 5044/7 … … … … … 4 odd days
So, after 5044 days, the day will be = Wednesday + 4 odd days = Sunday

description.text: If 3rd January, 2019 was Thursday, what was the day of the week on 31st December, 2019?

properties.html: If 3rd January, 2019 was Thursday, what was the day of the week on 31st December, 2019?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

1st January, 2019 was = Thursday – 2 odd days = Tuesday
Now, no. of odd days between 1st Jan, 2019 and 31st December, 2019 is = 364/7 … … … … … … … … 0 odd days
So, 31st December,2019 was also Thursday.

description.text: If Rima celebrated her birthday on 16th September, which is Monday, then on which day & on which date Rajesh will celebrate his birthday, if Rajesh is 55 days older than Rima?

properties.html: If Rima celebrated her birthday on 16th September, which is Monday, then on which day & on which date Rajesh will celebrate his birthday, if Rajesh is 55 days older than Rima?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

16th September + 55 days = 10th November
Now, no. of odd days = 55/7 … … … … … … (+6) 𝑜𝑟 (−1)
So, the day is = Monday – 1 odd day = Sunday
Therefore, correct answer is option (D) 10th November, Sunday.
